issue.title: Stop losing agent work in linked-repo checkouts
issue.description: Agent work in linked and external repo checkouts survives workspace reuse, raw local commits can never end a turn as a silent finalizer success, and monitors started inside an opened repo run there.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/protect_linked_repo_work.md requests this work
